Context: 12. Removal l Dismissal

Compassionate Allowance.If the case of the Government servant who is removed or dismissed from service deserves special consideration; the authority competent to remove or dismiss him from service may sanction a Compassionate Allowance not exceeding two-thirds of pension or gratuity or both which would have been admissible to him if he had retired on compensation pension. The Compassionate Allowance shall not be less than ~ 9,000 per month. Dearness Relief is also admissible orr the Compassionate
